description: Source code for the Ethernet driver 'eth_cyclonev' tailored for Intel Cyclone V SoC FPGA. Implements hardware initialization, configuration, transmit/receive handling, and interrupt processing for the Ethernet MAC (DWC_gmac). Includes functions for reset, MAC address setup, descriptor ring management, and device start/stop routines.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_reset
methods.description: Performs reset of the GMAC device, including system manager register adjustments.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_set_mac_addr
methods.description: Sets the MAC address registers for a specified instance and index.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_get_software_reset_status
methods.description: Checks the reset status of the DMA controller.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_software_reset
methods.description: Performs a software reset of the MAC subsystem and waits for completion.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_setup_rxdesc
methods.description: Initializes the receive descriptor ring with chained descriptors and ownership bits.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_setup_txdesc
methods.description: Initializes the transmit descriptor ring with chained descriptors and ownership bits.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes the network interface, sets link address, and IRQ configuration.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_set_config
methods.description: Configures MAC address or promiscuous mode based on input parameters.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_caps
methods.description: Returns the hardware capabilities of the device.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_send
methods.description: Transmits a packet by populating descriptors and managing DMA.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine handling DMA and link status interrupts.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_receive
methods.description: Handles received packets, copies data to network stack, and manages descriptors.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_tx_release
methods.description: Releases transmitted descriptors and updates semaphore.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_probe
methods.description: Initializes hardware, descriptors, and configures the Ethernet device.

methods.name: eth_cyclonev_stop
methods.description: Stops DMA and MAC transmitter/receiver, ensuring FIFO buffers are empty.
